title: last day of fringe 2025 and I am SAD (but also very grateful) #edfrin...
transcript: it's our last morning at the fringe our last donut last time at traverse it is our last day in Edinburgh it's very sad doing a little castle walk just saw our first show of the day consumed now I'm heading over to Bristo really sad to leave I'm not ready I'm seeing a hot mess later today but they very kindly gave me a little merch bag I'm obsessed with this hat and a tote bag I also got a shirt should I wear it all to the show maybe yes just finished show number two Alex is here nerds we just watched nerds about Steve Jobs Bill Gates I don't know if you guys have heard of those two people maybe Google them a great show five stars on mezzanine for me make sure you follow me on there still haven't signed up yet so we'll update you guys when I'm all signed up we are finally loading in for hot mess I'm so excited hot mess started 45 minutes late it was so so so so good I didn't even care it did make me 15 minutes late to my next show The Fit Prince and it was just this delightful little fairy tale with like a lot of audience parts that they had cast from the audience really funny really chill it was the team behind Gwyneth goes skiing that's actually coming back to New York like a great afternoon show now I have 30 minutes to get to Gilded Balloon for my final two shows of the fringe been the best week ever and we literally added two days from last year and it still is not enough time I needed an Acme to pick me up it's really good okay I'm very happy now last meal in Scotland I'm here with Joe go see Jackie I feel like I've seen so many shows yet I still haven't seen like any of these I am seeing this tonight though as my final fringe show sitting front row what a party hi oh perfect wow oh my god the funny thing is my last show of fringe last year and my last show of fringe this year same theatre perfect day what a perfect fringe I saw 40 shows happy Fringe Tomorrow I'm flying Amsterdam baby bye Bobby here we go see you next time
